video_script: What if the part of your AI coding agent that does the heavy lifting cost you nothing? We tested a local-first agent harness on 13 real SWE-bench Verified bugs. Here's the deal: the file-editing role — the one that grinds through the actual code changes — runs on a local model. That's a 0% cost share for the hardest-working part of the chain. The result? The local-first hybrid resolved 62% of the bugs — 8 out of 13 — while cloud fallback steps in to rescue the toughest ones. Full-cloud relay does land higher at 77%, 10 out of 13, but it costs $35.0. The hybrid? Just $15.7. That's a 55% cost saving on the same chain. And for comparison, a single-shot Opus run only solved 54%, 7 of 13. Every fix here was graded by the real SWE-bench Docker test oracle — actual tests, never an LLM judge guessing. You keep the honest local result, and cloud only jumps in when it's truly needed. Want to try it? pip install git+https://github.com/ziyilam3999/local-first-agent-harness.
